messages.text:
I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Restored arrow-key navigation in [Board.tsx](/work/src/game/board/Board.tsx). Arrows move focus within the current row or column, stop at board edges, and leave modified keys to the browser. Focus still scrolls into view and updates the board’s remembered tab stop through [use-board-focus.ts](/work/src/game/board/use-board-focus.ts).

Enter, Space, click, and touch activation behavior is unchanged. I didn’t run the tests.
